Title: Login with valid credentials
Steps:
1. open /login
2. fill username with admin
3. type "123456" into the password field
4. click the Login button
Expected:
redirected to /dashboard
see Welcome back, admin

Title: Wrong password shows an error
Steps:
1. go to the login page
2. fill username with admin
3. fill password with wrong
4. press Enter
Expected:
the message "Invalid username or password" is shown
stays on the login page

Title: Empty username cannot submit
Steps:
1. open /login
2. clear the username field
3. fill password with 123456

Title: Remember me is off by default
Expected:
Remember me is unchecked
title is Login

Title: Logout
Steps:
1. sign in
2. click Logout
3. confirm the dialog
